text:
### Task 1: Design plan

**Topology:** a two-stage op-amp. Stage 1 is an NMOS-input folded cascode. Stage 2 is an NMOS common-source stage. Compensation is Miller with a nulling resistor.

**Why this topology:** a plain two-stage Miller amplifier gives only about 83 dB in SKY130. The cascoded first stage adds about 30 dB. The NMOS input pair is required because the PMOS |Vth| of about 1 V leaves no headroom at VCM = 0.9 V.

**Folding direction:** the first stage folds into a wide-swing NMOS cascode mirror. Its output node o1 then sits at about one NMOS Vgs (~0.65 V). That is exactly the gate bias the second-stage NMOS needs. M13 has the same current density as M9/M10, so the systematic offset is close to zero.

**Signal path (node names):**

| Device | Connection | Role |
|---|---|---|
| M1 / M2 | gates vinn / vinp; drains f1 / f2; source tail | NMOS input pair, 20 µA each, W/L = 12/0.5, gm/Id ≈ 14 |
| M11 | tail to vss, gate ibias | Tail current source, 40 µA (4× ref) |
| M3 / M4 | vdd to f1 / f2, gate vbp | PMOS folding current sources, 40 µA each (Itail/2 + 20 µA cascode branch) |
| M5 / M6 | f1 to x1, f2 to o1, gate vbpc | PMOS cascodes, 20 µA each |
| M7 / M8 | gate vbnc; x1/o1 to a1/a2 | NMOS cascodes |
| M9 / M10 | a1/a2 to vss, gates tied to x1 | Bottom mirror, wide-swing self-biased cascode mirror |
| M13 | gate o1, drain vout | 2nd-stage NMOS common-source, 80 µA |
| M14 | vdd to vout, gate vbp | PMOS current-source load for stage 2 |
| Rz, Cc | o1 – cz – vout | Miller compensation, 2.5 kΩ + 4 pF |

**Polarity check:**
- A rise on vinp raises the M2 current, so the M6 current falls.
- With the mirror sink fixed, o1 falls, and M13 then drives vout up.
- So vinp is the non-inverting input.
- The Miller loop through the inverting CS stage gives negative feedback.

**DC bias** (all derived from the 10 µA sunk by diode MB0 at ibias, gate node = ibias):

| Bias node | Circuit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| vbp | MB1 sinks 10 µA into PMOS diode MB2 | M3/M4/M14/MB5 mirror it at equal density (0.6 µm/µA) |
| vbpc | R1 (30 k) in series with PMOS diode MB4, fed by MB3 (10 µA) | vbpc = VDD − 0.3 V − Vsg; M3/M4 get Vsd ≈ 0.3 V |
| vbnc | MB5 (10 µA) into NMOS diode MB6 over R2 (25 k) | vbnc = 0.25 V + Vgs; M9/M10 get Vds ≈ 0.25 V |

MB4 and MB6 have the same current density and body bias as the cascodes they replicate.

**Hand estimates:**

| Quantity | Estimate |
|---|---|
| Supply current | 10 (ref) + 30 (bias branches) + 80 (folded cascode) + 80 (stage 2) = 200 µA |
| Power | ≈ 360 µW (limit 500 µW) |
| gm1 | ≈ 280 µS |
| Rout at o1 | ≈ 13 MΩ |
| Stage 1 gain | ≈ 71 dB |
| Stage 2 gain | gm13 ≈ 0.88 mS, ≈ 39 dB |
| Total A0 | ≈ 105–110 dB |
| GBW | gm1 / (2π·Cc) ≈ 11 MHz |
| Output pole p2 | ≈ gm13 / (2π·(CL + C1)) ≈ 27 MHz |
| Rz | ≈ (1 + CL/Cc)/gm13 ≈ 2.5 kΩ, places the LHP zero near p2 |
| Phase margin | ≈ 65–70° |
| Folding-node and mirror poles | > 100 MHz |
| Slew rate | 40 µA / 4 pF = 10 V/µs |
| Output swing | ≈ 0.15 V to 1.6 V (> 1 V) |

### Task 2: Netlist

```spice
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---------- bias generation ----------
MB0  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=5   L=1
MB1  vbp   ibias vss  vss nfet W=5   L=1
MB2  vbp   vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=6   L=1
MB3  vbpc  ibias vss  vss nfet W=5   L=1
MB4  vbpc  vbpc  n1   vdd pfet W=5   L=0.5
R1   vdd   n1    30k
MB5  vbnc  vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=6   L=1
MB6  vbnc  vbnc  n2   vss nfet W=1.5 L=0.5
R2   n2    vss   25k
* ---------- stage 1: NMOS-input folded cascode ----------
M11  tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=20  L=1
M1   f1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=12  L=0.5
M2   f2    vinp  tail vss nfet W=12  L=0.5
M3   f1    vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=24  L=1
M4   f2    vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=24  L=1
M5   x1    vbpc  f1   vdd pfet W=10  L=0.5
M6   o1    vbpc  f2   vdd pfet W=10  L=0.5
M7   x1    vbnc  a1   vss nfet W=3   L=0.5
M8   o1    vbnc  a2   vss nfet W=3   L=0.5
M9   a1    x1    vss  vss nfet W=4   L=1
M10  a2    x1    vss  vss nfet W=4   L=1
* ---------- stage 2: NMOS common source ----------
M13  vout  o1    vss  vss nfet W=16  L=1
M14  vout  vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=48  L=1
* ---------- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----------
Rz   o1    cz    2.5k
Cc   cz    vout  4p
.ends
```
